title: ForgeGlyphs
description: Forge Glyphs — adds 15 armor glyphs via the smithing table. Effects: magnetism, arrow deflection, cactus immunity, Creeper repulsion, and others.
body: .Forge Glyphs — enchant your armor at the smithing table. Choose from 15 unique effects, ranging from magnetism and cactus immunity to Dolphin's Grace and Creeper repulsion. Each armor piece provides 25% of the effect's power—assemble the full set and feel the difference. Mix materials, combine templates, and become more invulnerable, faster, and stronger.
